mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right general contractor for a commercial buildout?

acceptedAnswer.text: To choose the right general contractor, verify their commercial contracting license, active insurance coverage, and experience with your specific business category, such as retail, medical, or office spaces. Look for a contractor who understands commercial lease constraints, landlord work-letter guidelines, and local trade coordination. Ask candidates how they handle unexpected site conditions, change orders, and communication with property managers. Selecting a contractor who participates during the pre-construction phase can help identify constructability issues early and keep your budget aligned with your lease allowance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed commercial contractor with proven experience in your facility type, strong communication for landlord coordination, and transparent cost-tracking processes.
